newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA soymeal export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 44,100 MT were 47 percent below the week earlier and the 4-week average.

Major increases for Saudi Arabia (15,000 MT), Japan (11,800 MT), the Netherlands (10,700 MT), the Dominican Republic (10,400 MT), and Italy (10,300 MT) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (10,900 MT), Australia (10,000 MT), Ecuador (8,000 MT), and South Africa (7,100 MT).
Exports of 222,200 MT were 4 percent above the previous week and 9 percent over the 4-week average. The Philippines (52,800 MT), Egypt (45,700 MT), and Spain (45,300 MT) were the major recipients
